Name: Sleepy Eye
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Sleepy Eye[/b] lets you buy a reusable tent to sleep anywhere!

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
Sleep here. Sleep there. Sleep everywhere!

You can buy the tent from Pierre's shop for 5000g. Select it in your toolbar and [b]hold[/b] left-click for seven seconds (configurable) to go to sleep.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
